hooks.command: if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE '(git commit|git push)'; then cd /home/user/research_paper_sddw && python3 scripts/validate-structure.py && python3 scripts/validate-citations.py; fi
if echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -qE 'paper/sections/|paper/outline\.md'; then cd /home/user/research_paper_sddw && python3 scripts/validate-word-count.py 2>/dev/null || true; fi
